HOW_IT_HAPPENED.cause: run_hog_psp_v3_production.build_config disables three flags in a loop copied verbatim from OG-PSP's runner: rasr_regime_qpsi, rasr_private_critic_heads, rasr_directed_identity. The loop was carried over without examining what each flag controlled.
HOW_IT_HAPPENED.why_it_was_harmless_in_OG_PSP: OG-PSP had no private actor capacity, so actor/critic asymmetry could not arise.
HOW_IT_HAPPENED.why_the_smokes_could_not_catch_it: The smokes verified the mechanisms that were wired. This was a mechanism deliberately switched off in a line that was never read, so no liveness check covered it.
HOW_IT_HAPPENED.recorded_plainly: This was an implementation oversight by the executing agent, not a PI decision and not a property of the hypothesis.

AMENDMENT_1_ARCHITECTURAL_LIMITATION_FOU.WHY_IT_IS_A_PLAUSIBLE_CHOKE_POINT: PPO does not optimise the actor from strategy identity directly. It optimises through advantages: r_t -> V -> A_hat -> grad L_PPO. If two strategies induce different return landscapes, a single shared value estimator is the funnel through which both receive compromised task-learning signal. Multi-style RL work (MultiCriticAL, ICLR 2022) identifies exactly this: a style-conditioned actor can show clearly different behaviours while a shared critic compromises their performance.
AMENDMENT_1_ARCHITECTURAL_LIMITATION_FOU.WHAT_V3_STILL_ESTABLISHES: V3 remains a VALID terminal result for private-actor / shared-critic H-OG-PSP. Its trajectory-identity confirmation and its payoff failure both stand. What changes is only the precision of the claim: V3 did not test private value estimation, so its negative payoff result does not speak to that axis.
AMENDMENT_1_ARCHITECTURAL_LIMITATION_FOU.successor: HOG_PSP_V4_SPEC.json -- one axis changed, private critic heads only
